entities.summary: Mark David Beaufait is an American former professional ice hockey player. He resides in Grand Rapids, Michigan. He played 5 games in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the San Jose Sharks during the 1992–93 season. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1992 to 2009, was spent mainly in the International Hockey League and in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga, where he won 4 championships with Eisbären Berlin. Internationally, he played for the American national team at the 1994 Winter Olympics.
